999008199.text:
ふう……いやあ、美味しかった！
やっぱり『星の繭』の飯は格別だな

localizations.en: Phew... Man, that was delicious! Nothing beats a meal at Star's Cocoon.

999008199.text: 少し落ち着いたら街を出ましょうか

localizations.en: Now that we've had a moment to relax, shall we head out of town?

999008199.text:
……見た？　あの屋台。
ひたすら石札を求めてて、得体が知れないな

localizations.en: ...Did you see that stall? They keep asking for stone tablets, but nobody knows what they're really after.

999008199.text: そもそもラランってなんなんだろうねェ

前それっぽい石札を持って行ってみたら、
「それではありません」って言われたって

localizations.en: I heard someone brought them a stone tablet that looked about right, but they just said 'That's not it.'

999008199.text: うーん。いったい何を探してるんだか、謎だねェ

localizations.en: Hmm. What could they possibly be looking for? It's a real mystery.

999008199.text:
……噂になってますね。
ワルターさん、どうしてしまったんでしょうか

localizations.en: ...People are talking about it. I wonder what's gotten into Mr. Walther.

999008199.text:
街中で噂になってるぜ。まあ、誰にも迷惑が
かかってないから放っておかれてるけど

localizations.en: The whole town's buzzing about it. Well, he's not bothering anyone, so they're just letting him be.

999008199.text:
（ワルターの言っていたことは本当のようね。
　準備は万端ってことかしら）

localizations.en: (So what Walther said was true. I suppose everything is ready, then.)

999008199.text:
まあ、何か事情があるんだろう。
さ、早く海に戻ろう！　ララ様が待ってるよ

localizations.en: Well, he must have his reasons. Come on, let's get back to the beach! Queen Lara's waiting for us.

999008199.text: そうね。それじゃあ、出発するとしましょう

localizations.en: Right. Well then, let's be on our way.
